topic: What interference mitigation techniques are viable for overlapping service transmissions across geographically dispersed ground stations?
consensus_response: Viable techniques include MIMO, RSMA, adaptive frequency allocation, TDMA, HARQ, beamforming, and ML-based predictive beamforming. These methods reduce interference by spatially nulling signals, improving SINR and capacity. Edge Computing and Federated Learning enhance real-time performance and model accuracy while preserving privacy.
reference_context: Research highlights importance of interference mitigation in satellite-terrestrial systems, citing techniques like rate-splitting and beamforming to maintain high-integrity transmission.
